proposed_comments.title: Preserve all clipboard formats during UI tests
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve all clipboard formats during UI tests

**Severity:** `medium`

`PrepareSource` snapshots only clipboard text, so a developer who starts a local Test Explorer run with an image, file list, or another non-text format will have that data cleared during cleanup. Please capture and restore a detached clipboard data object through the existing STA helper instead of treating ‘no text’ as an empty clipboard; this requires a small helper addition outside the PR diff and matching field/cleanup updates in `CropAndLockTests`.

confidence.rationale: The current code calls GetText and then Clear when the result is empty, which deterministically discards any non-text clipboard formats.

proposed_comments.title: Wait through placeholder shortcut values and accept named keys

confidence.rationale: The Settings control placeholder and the harness Key enum are directly visible; the existing single-letter guard excludes supported named keys.

proposed_comments.title: Remove fixture registrations even when cancellation fails

confidence.rationale: CancelPendingInstallation can throw on timeout or task failure, and the following cleanup call is therefore bypassed in the current control flow.

proposed_comments.title: Keep fixture build intermediates outside tests artifacts
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep fixture build intermediates outside tests artifacts

**Severity:** `low`

The fixture's full self-contained runtime is emitted under `tests/**`, while the packaged MSIX is also staged beside the UI-test executable. The build artifact glob therefore uploads the same large runtime twice even though only the staged MSIX is consumed; move the intermediate output outside the test artifact tree.

```suggestion
    <OutputPath>$(RepoRoot)$(Platform)\$(Configuration)\test-fixtures\CropAndLock.TestApp\</OutputPath>
```

confidence.rationale: The UI-test artifact explicitly copies tests/**, and the project also stages its generated MSIX into the UITests output.

proposed_comments.title: Fail signing preparation when the fixture is absent
proposed_comments.body:
### Fail signing preparation when the fixture is absent

**Severity:** `medium`

`-Include` only filters packages that happen to exist. Because the required Runner and Settings files can still be found, this command can succeed and export a certificate without signing `CropAndLock.TestApp.msix`, leaving the documented VM preparation incomplete. Mark the fixture as required so setup fails immediately.

```suggestion
    -Include CropAndLock.TestApp.msix `
    -RequiredPackage CropAndLock.TestApp.msix `
```

confidence.rationale: signSparsePackages.ps1 distinguishes Include from RequiredPackage and only the latter fails when no matching package exists.

proposed_comments.title: Apply the documented local-skip policy to missing files

confidence.rationale: The current File.Exists assertion deterministically bypasses the local-versus-pipeline policy implemented immediately above it.

proposed_comments.title: Do not assert package existence before the prerequisite policy
proposed_comments.body:
### Do not assert package existence before the prerequisite policy

**Severity:** `medium`

Even after `ReadSignature` understands a missing file, this earlier assertion would still hard-fail local Test Explorer runs. Let `RequirePackage` own both existence and signing classification so the documented local inconclusive behavior is reachable.

```suggestion
            var packagePath = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "CropAndLock.TestApp.msix");
            SigningPrerequisites.RequirePackage(packagePath);
```

confidence.rationale: The assertion precedes RequirePackage and therefore necessarily prevents the missing-prerequisite classification from running.

proposed_comments.title: Cover the missing-file prerequisite state
proposed_comments.body:
### Cover the missing-file prerequisite state

**Severity:** `low`

Add the new `Missing` state to the shared local-skip/CI-fail matrix so the policy cannot regress independently of the other signing setup failures.

```suggestion
            new("NotSigned", "Unsigned fixture.", string.Empty, false),
            new("Missing", "Fixture was not staged.", string.Empty, false),
            new("NotTrusted", "Untrusted signer.", "Microsoft Corporation", false),
```

confidence.rationale: The existing parameterized tests already define the expected local and CI behavior for every missing-setup status.
